args.message: City revenue = sum of order amounts per (region, customer city); averaged unweighted per region. The null-region group contains Paris (677.83, customer 9002 has no region) and 6 orders with no customer at all (515.47, null city), averaging 596.65. If orphan orders were excluded, the null group would be 677.83.
